description: This file defines a generated UI class for a Qt dialog, created from a .ui file using Qt Designer. It sets up user interface elements such as checkboxes, labels, line edits, buttons, and layout containers for a dialog titled 'Set modifiers'. The code specifies the visual arrangement and widget properties but does not include custom logic or behavior implementations.

classes.name: Ui_Dialog
classes.description: A class generated to configure the user interface for a dialog window using PySide6 widgets and layouts.

methods.name: setupUi(self, Dialog)
methods.description: Initializes and arranges all UI components within the dialog, setting properties such as sizes, object names, text labels, and widget hierarchy.
